evidence_caveats: VEPO compares different images with the same answer, not standard same-input DPO. PALO corpus size is not selected training count; Hi English mixing and single-run limitation explicit. Attention is a proxy, not a causal guarantee.

Reviso PAR evaluates initial plan; group gate controls UTCP for every trajectory, not just successful ones. Matching 128 frames does not equal matching latency/tool/teacher costs. Missing numeric reward weights/budget/group size are not imputed.

SurgQ 49x raw vs 11x post-merge compression denominators distinguished; 45 frame instances versus 30 distinct frames; compressor freezes in RL; Q-type weighting after advantage normalization; 21.2GB is inference memory.

ZeroVLN brain is 35B-A3B, not 4B. Zero refers only to navigation-domain brain SFT; action supervision exists. Shared RLOO advantage with separate gradient paths. SR improves while R2R/RxR SPL lower than controlled NaVILA.

Anti-hallucination audit removal accounting is not net CHAIR; newly added hallucinations separate. InternVL accounting failure and failed human evaluator gate included. CLIP/probe DPO recovery and length-matched random control distinguished.
